Next steps for acme/Hello.Web (image name hello-web):

  1. Create its two ECR repositories, with immutable tags, and one publisher role for
     each. maul's reference terraform module does that; in your terraform root:
       module "maul_app_hello_web" {
         source = "git::https://github.com/devthenet-labs/maul.git//deploy/terraform/aws/modules/app?ref=vX.Y.Z"

         slug = "hello-web"
         github = {
           owner            = "acme"
           name             = "Hello.Web"
           repository_id    = "<id>" # gh api repos/acme/Hello.Web --jq .id
           owner_id         = "<id>" # gh api repos/acme/Hello.Web --jq .owner.id
           default_branch   = "main"
           sub_claim_prefix = "<prefix>" # gh api repos/acme/Hello.Web/actions/oidc/customization/sub --jq .sub_claim_prefix
         }
         # The account's GitHub Actions OIDC provider, created once per account.
         github_oidc_provider_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
         # Optional: sign the agent image with this KMS key (.github/actions/publish/README.md).
         # agent_signing_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:123456789012:key/<key-id>"
       }
       output "maul_app_hello_web_variables" {
         value = module.maul_app_hello_web.github_variables_dotenv
       }
     This CLI is a development build: pin ref to the maul release you deploy.
     It creates
       agent    123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/maul/app-envs/hello-web
       runtime  123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/maul/previews/hello-web
     and roles that each trust only this repository's main branch and their own
     publisher workflow, .github/workflows/publish-agent.yml or publish-runtime.yml.
     With the platform module (deploy/terraform/aws, at the same ref), add an apps
     entry keyed hello-web instead: its github_variables_dotenv output holds the same
     variables under that key.
  2. Set the publishers' repository variables (none is secret) from the module's
     output, on this repository only: an organization variable reaches every
     repository with these workflows, a template repository and its copies included.
       terraform output -raw maul_app_hello_web_variables | gh variable set -f - --repo acme/Hello.Web
     With the platform module, from a root output that re-exports its
     github_variables_dotenv:
       terraform output -json github_variables_dotenv | jq -r '."hello-web"' | gh variable set -f - --repo acme/Hello.Web
     Without the module, .github/actions/publish/README.md lists the variables. Then
     switch on the agent image's publisher:
       gh variable set AGENT_PUBLISH_ENABLED --repo acme/Hello.Web --body true
  3. Commit and push to main. The push builds the agent image and publishes it as
     toolchain-v1, the tag .maul/agent.yaml declares. If it was pushed before step 2, run
       gh workflow run "agent image" --repo acme/Hello.Web
     and confirm the tag exists before creating the Project:
       aws ecr describe-images --region eu-west-2 --repository-name maul/app-envs/hello-web --image-ids imageTag=toolchain-v1
  4. When the Project previews this repository, publish its runtime images:
       gh variable set PREVIEW_PUBLISH_ENABLED --repo acme/Hello.Web --body true
     The Project's preview fields for it:
       imageRepository: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/maul/previews/hello-web
       port: 8080
       readinessPath: /healthz
  5. Add the repository to its Project:
       maul setup project <name> ... --repo hello-web=acme/Hello.Web
       kubectl apply -f <name>.project.yaml
     add acme/Hello.Web to the GitHub App's installation, then check the Project:
       GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) maul check project <name> -n <namespace>

To change the agent toolchain later, edit .maul/Dockerfile and bump the tag in
.maul/agent.yaml (toolchain-v2, ...) in the same commit: tags are immutable.
If the registry moves, change ECR_REGISTRY, AGENT_IMAGE_REPOSITORY and the image in
.maul/agent.yaml together. .github/actions/publish/README.md describes the publishers.
